subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-08T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification

Hi Jordan -

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so we can put together a tailored dedicated capacity quote for Acme: 

Summary from our call:
- Use case: document summarization + chat assistant for enterprise support (private data, low-latency requirement).
- Expected production model: LlamaX-7B-quant (or comparable), generation lengths ~150-300 tokens on average.

Info we need to finalize options (can you confirm the items below?):
1) Monthly token volumes (approx): average and peak months if you have them - e.g., 150M / 250M tokens.
2) Peak throughput targets: concurrent requests or requests/sec during peak (and typical request size).
3) Budget range / target unit economics: what are you aiming for on $/1M tokens or monthly spend?
4) Any GPU preference or constraint (A100 vs H100) or procurement restrictions.
5) Required term/commit (12/24 months) and any billing constraints (PO process, required contract terms).
6) Any compliance items to surface now (SOC2 scope, data residency).

What we'll propose: a dedicated cluster configuration (GPU type + reserved capacity size), estimated throughput, and a target $/1M tokens for the committed term. I attached a quick estimate workbook that outlines the typical configs and unit economics - please fill in or confirm the numbers when you can.

Attachments: RWD-dedicated-pricing-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet with sample configs)

Next steps:
- If you can reply with the items above, I'll run a configuration through Marcus and put together both an A100 and H100 option plus a small burst policy for peaks.
- If it helps, we can do a 30-minute follow-up to walk through the spreadsheet.

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Michaels <jordan.michaels@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the recap. Confirming answers below so you have everything you need: 

1) Monthly tokens (estimate):
- Typical month: ~180M tokens
- Peak month (seasonal): up to ~260M tokens

2) Peak throughput:
- Concurrent active users during peak: ~1,200
- Typical request size: avg ~220 tokens (prompt+response)
- Peak QPS: roughly ~20-30 req/s for heavy periods (spiky bursts up to ~60 req/s for short windows)

3) Budget / unit economics:
- Budget range we can commit to initially: $25k-$40k/month
- Our procurement target for unit economics: ideally $1,200-$1,800 per 1M tokens (we understand it depends on config/commit).

4) GPU preference:
- We prefer H100 if available for better throughput on multi-head generation, but procurement will consider A100 if the price delta is material.

5) Term: we prefer 12-24 month commit depending on price. PO process: procurement@acme.com is the contact (attached vCard).

6) Compliance: SOC2 required; data residency in US is fine.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to go over options. If you can send a preliminary configuration and target $/1M tokens for both an A100 and H100 config, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Michaels
Head of AI Platforms | Acme Corp
jordan.michaels@acme.com

Marissa / Vanessa -

Looping in a quick internal note after Jordan's numbers. Key points for quote construction:

- Tokens: target 180-260M/month. Given avg 220 tokens/request, that's roughly ~0.8-1.2M requests/month.
- Throughput: peaks are spiky (up to ~60 req/s) but sustained QPS is low. We should size for baseline concurrency and add burst capacity.
- GPU recommendation:
  * H100 (best perf) - recommend 2x H100 reserved for steady state + 1x H100 burst pool for peaks. This gives lower latency and headroom for complex prompts.
  * A100 option - 3x A100 reserved to match throughput; cheaper per-node but needs more nodes and slightly higher latency.
- Term and pricing: propose a 12-month commit baseline with optional 24-month term discount. Target starting price: $1,500 per 1M tokens (H100 config). Provide an A100 option at ~10-15% higher $/1M or structured as more nodes for same price.
- Extras: include autoscale/burst policy (+15% over reserved) and a 48-hour SLA on critical incidents for Dedicated customers on enterprise plan.

Next steps for me: I'll run a perf model and put numbers into the attached pricing sheet for both configs (H100 vs A100). We can send the preliminary commercial after Marcus runs the estimate.

-Marcus
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

Thanks Jordan - this is super helpful. Quick summary from our side and proposed next steps: 

What we heard:
- Monthly volume: 180M typical / up to 260M peak
- Peak: short bursts up to ~60 req/s; sustained lower QPS
- Budget: $25k-$40k/month; target $/1M tokens: $1.2k-$1.8k
- Preference: H100 preferred, SOC2 + US residency required

Recommended preliminary options (we'll include full line-item in the quote):
1) H100 primary (recommended) - 2x reserved H100 nodes for baseline + 1x H100 burst pool (auto-scale) for short peaks. 12-month commit. Estimated throughput and economics: target $1,500 per 1M tokens.
2) A100 alternative - 3x reserved A100 nodes, 12-month commit. Slightly lower per-node cost but you need more nodes; estimated $/1M tokens ~ $1,700.

Notes on sizing and throughput: Marcus ran the numbers - 2x H100 reserved should comfortably handle your steady-state and typical peaks when combined with a burst pool (auto-scale window to ~3 nodes). We'll include explicit throughput numbers (tokens/sec and expected latency) in the formal quote.

Next steps:
- I'll send a formal preliminary quote (A100 + H100 options) and an outline of the commercial + SLA today by EOD.
- If that looks good, can we schedule a 30-min call early next week to walk the commercial and sign the PO? If yes, send a few slots and we'll lock one.
- I've CC'd procurement; feel free to share any mandatory contract terms up front.

Attachments: RWD-dedicated-pricing-estimate.xlsx (updated), acme-procurement-contact.vcf
Related links: HubSpot deal https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567; DocuSign placeholder https://www.docusign.com/ACME/12345

Thanks - looking forward to getting this on paper.
